format: &str,\n1008\t) -> Result<()> {\n1009\t    // Parse annotation filter (key=value format)\n1010\t    let annotation_filter = match annotation {\n1011\t        Some(ref ann) => {\n1012\t Ok(())\n1082\t}\n1083\t\n1084\tfn cmd_show(beads_dir: &PathBuf, id: &str, format: &str) -> Result<()> {\n1085\t    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n1086\t    let db_path = };\n1097\t\n1098\t    match format {\n1099\t        \"json\" => {\n1100\t            // Strip dependencies/comments before serializing: NEEDLE's BrDependency\n1101\t            // format ({id, title, Result<Cli> {\n    Ok(Cli::parse())\n}\n\npub fn run(cli: Cli) -> Result<()> {\n    let workspace = cli.workspace.unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(\".\"));\n\n    // Handle case where no subcommand is provided\n    let command = match cli.command {\n        None => {\n            // clap handles --help automatically, exiting before this point\n            // If we reach here, it means no valid flag was provided\n            return Err(anyhow!(\"No command provided. Use 'bf --help' for usage information.\"));\n        }\n        Some(cmd) => cmd,\n    };\n\n    // Handle Init command specially (doesn't require existing .beads directory)\n    if let Commands::Init { prefix } = &command {\n        let beads_dir = workspace.join(\".beads\");\n        return cmd_init(&beads_dir, prefix);\n    }\n\n    // All other commands require existing .beads directory\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(&workspace)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {:?}\", workspace))?;\n\n    match command {\n        Commands::Create {\n            title,\n            type_,\n            priority,\n            description,\n            assignee,\n            label,\n        } => cmd_create(\n            &beads_dir,\n            title,\n            type_,\n            priority,\n            description,\n            assignee,\n            label,\n        ),\n        Commands::List {\n            status,\n            type_,\n            assignee,\n            priority,\n            annotation,\n            limit,\n            all,\n            format,\n            json,\n        } => {\n            let format = if json { \"json\".to_string() } else { format };\n            cmd_list(\n                &beads_dir, status, type_, assignee, priority, annotation, limit, all, &format,\n            )\n        }\n        Commands::Show { id, format, json } => {\n            let format = if json { \"json\".to_string() } else { format };\n            cmd_show(&beads_dir, &id, &format)\n        }\n        Commands::Update {\n            id,\n            title,\n            status,\n            priority,\n            assignee,\n            description,\n            acceptance_criteria,\n            notes,\n            design,\n            due_at,\n        } => cmd_update(\n            &beads_dir,\n            &id,\n            title,\n            status,\n            priority,\n            assignee,\n            description,\n            acceptance_criteria,\n            notes,\n            design,\n            due_at,\n        ),\n        Commands::Close { id, reason } => cmd_close(&beads_dir, &id, &reason),\n        Commands::Reopen { id } => cmd_reopen(&beads_dir, &id),\n        Commands::Delete { id } => cmd_delete(&beads_dir, &id),\n        Commands::Ready {\n            limit,\n            format,\n            json,\n        } => {\n            let format = if json { \"json\".to_string() } else { format };\n            cmd_ready(&beads_dir, limit, &format)\n        }\n        Commands::Claim {\n            assignee,\n            model,\n            harness,\n            harness_version,\n            any,\n            fallback,\n            workspace_paths,\n            dry_run,\n            format,\n            json,\n        } => {\n            let format = if json { \"json\".to_string() } else { format };\n            cmd_claim(\n                &beads_dir,\n                &assignee,\n                model,\n                harness,\n                harness_version,\n                any,\n                fallback.as_deref(),\n                &workspace_paths,\n                dry_run,\n                &format,\n            )\n        }\n        Commands::Sync {\n            flush_only,\n            import_only,\n        } => cmd_sync(&beads_dir, flush_only, import_only),\n        Commands::Doctor {\n            repair,\n            flush_first,\n            force,\n            reclaim_stale,\n            ttl,\n        } => cmd_doctor(&beads_dir, repair, flush_first, force, reclaim_stale, ttl),\n        Commands::CommitCheck => cmd_commit_check(&beads_dir),\n        Commands::Count { status } => cmd_count(&beads_dir, status),\n        Commands::Batch { file, json, stdin } => cmd_batch(&beads_dir, file, json, stdin),\n        Commands::Mitosis {\n            id,\n            children,\n            reason,\n            format,\n        } => cmd_mitosis(&beads_dir, &id, &children, &reason, &format),\n        Commands::Dep(dep) => cmd_dep(&beads_dir, dep),\n        Commands::Label(label) => cmd_label(&beads_dir, label),\n        Commands::Comments(comments) => cmd_comments(&beads_dir, comments),\n        Commands::Search {\n            query,\n            status,\n            type_,\n            assignee,\n            label,\n            priority_min,\n            priority_max,\n            limit,\n            format,\n        } => cmd_search(\n            &beads_dir,\n            query,\n Commands::Stats {\n            by_type,\n            by_priority,\n            by_assignee,\n            by_label,\n            format,\n        } => cmd_stats(\n            &beads_dir,\n     Commands::Config(config) => cmd_config(&beads_dir, config),\n        Commands::Velocity {\n            model,\n            harness,\n            format,\n        } => cmd_velocity(&beads_dir, model, harness, &format),\n        Commands::Labels { id, format } => cmd_labels(&beads_dir, &id, &format),\n        Commands::Annotate(annotate) => cmd_annotate(&beads_dir, annotate),\n        Commands::Log {\n            id,\n            limit,\n            since,\n            actor,\n            status_changes,\n            diff,\n            git,\n            format,\n            json,\n   since,\n                actor,\n                status_changes,\n                diff,\n                git,\n                &format,\n            )\n        }\n        Commands::CriticalPath {\n beads_dir.join(\"config.yaml\");\n    if !config_path.exists() {\n        let config = format!(\n            r#\"issue_prefixes: [{}]\ndefault_priority: 2\ndefault_type: task\nclaim_ttl_minutes: 30\n\"#,\n            prefix\n        );\n        std::fs::write(&config_path, config)?;\n    }\n\n    let metadata_path = beads_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n    if !metadata_path.exists() {\n        let metadata = r#\"{\"database\": \"beads.db\", \"jsonl_export\": \"issues.jsonl\"}\"#;\n        std::fs::write(&metadata_path, metadata)?;\n    }\n\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(\"beads.db\");\n    let _storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let gitignore_path = beads_dir.join(\".gitignore\");\n    if !gitignore_path.exists() {\n        std::fs::write(&gitignore_path, \"beads.db\\nbeads.db-shm\\nbeads.db-wal\\n\")?;\n    }\n\n    println!(\"Initialized bead-forge workspace in {:?}\", beads_dir);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_create(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    title: String,\n    type_: String,\n    priority: i32,\n    description: Option<String>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    labels: Vec<String>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open_with_config(&db_path, &config)?;\n\n    let count = storage.count_issues()?;\n    let prefix = get_default_prefix(&config);\n    let id = crate::id::generate_id(prefix, count);\n\n    let mut issue = Issue::new(id.clone(), title, \".\".to_string());\n    issue.issue_type = IssueType::from_str(type_.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n    issue.priority = Priority(priority);\n    issue.description = description;\n    issue.assignee = assignee;\n    issue.labels = labels;\n\n    storage.create_issue(&issue)?;\n\n    println!(\"{}\", id);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_list(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    status: Option<String>,\n    type_: Option<String>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    priority: Option<i32>,\n    annotation: Option<String>,\n    limit: Option<usize>,\n    all: bool,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Parse annotation filter (key=value format)\n    let annotation_filter = match annotation {\n        Some(ref ann) => {\n            let parts: Vec<&str> = ann.splitn(2, '=').collect();\n            if parts.len() != 2 {\n                return Err(anyhow!(\"Invalid annotation format. Use key=value\"));\n            }\n            Some((parts[0].to_string(), parts[1].to_string()))\n        }\n        None => None,\n    };\n\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let mut issues = if all {\n        // Include archived beads\n        list_all_with_archives(beads_dir)?\n    } else {\n        // Only from database\n        let mut filter = IssueFilter::default();\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            filter.status = Some(Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            filter.issue_type =\n                Some(IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        filter.assignee = assignee.clone();\n        filter.priority = priority;\n        filter.annotation = annotation_filter.clone();\n        // --limit 0 means unlimited\n        filter.limit = limit.and_then(|l| if l == 0 { None } else { Some(l) });\n        storage.list_issues(&filter)?\n    };\n\n    // Apply additional filters for --all mode (since we're not using DB filters)\n    if all {\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            let status_filter = Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.status == status_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            let type_filter = IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.issue_type == type_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref assignee_val) = assignee {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.assignee.as_deref() == Some(assignee_val));\n        }\n        if let Some(p) = priority {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.priority.0 == p);\n        }\n        if let Some((ref key, ref value)) = annotation_filter {\n            issues.retain(|i| {\n                i.annotations\n                    .get(key)\n                    .map_or(false, |v| v == value)\n            });\n        }\n        // Apply limit\n        if let Some(l) = limit {\n            if l != 0 {\n                issues.truncate(l);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let output_format = OutputFormat::from_str(format).unwrap_or(OutputFormat::Text);\n    let formatter = get_formatter(output_format);\n    print!(\"{}\", formatter.format_issues(&issues));\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_show(beads_dir: &PathBuf, id: &str, format: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let issue = match storage.get_issue(id)? {\n        Some(i) => i,\n        None => {\n            // Search archives\n            find_bead_in_archives(beads_dir,           // Wrap in array so NEEDLE's parse_single_bead (Vec<Bead> → first) works.\n            println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string(&vec![out])?);\n        }\n        \"toon\" => {\n      println!(\"Type: {}\", issue.issue_type);\n            if let Some(desc) = &issue.description {\n                println!(\"Description: {}\", desc);\n            }\n            if let Some(assignee) = &issue.assignee {\n                println!(\"Assignee: {}\", assignee);\n            }\n            if !issue.labels.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"Labels: {}\", issue.labels.join(\", \"));\n            }\n        }\n        _ => {\n            println!(\"ID: {}\", issue.id);\n            println!(\"Title: {}\", issue.title);\n            println!(\"Status: {}\", issue.status);\n            println!(\"Priority: {}\", issue.priority);\n            println!(\"Type: {}\", issue.issue_type);\n            if let Some(desc) = &issue.description {\n                println!(\"Description: {}\", desc);\n            }\n            if let Some(assignee) = &issue.assignee {\n                println!(\"Assignee: {}\", assignee);\n            }\n            if    };\n\n    println!(\"{}\", count);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_batch(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    file: Option<PathBuf>,\n    json: Option<String>,\n    stdin: bool,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let cmd_mitosis(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    id: &str,\n    children: &str,\n    reason: &str,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let metadata =        println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&results)?);\n        }\n        _ => {\n            // Print child IDs that were created\n            for result in &results {\n                if print_dep_tree(nodes: &[crate::storage::DepTreeNode], _storage: &Storage) -> Result<()> {\n    if nodes.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"  (no dependencies)\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // Status indicators: ●=open, ◐=in_progress, ○=closed/blocked/deferred, ⊘=tombstone\n    let status_symbol = |status: &str| -> char {\n        match status {\n            \"open\" => '●',\n            \"in_progress\" => '◐',\n            \"closed\" => '○',\n            \"blocked\" => '◌',\n            \"deferred\" => '○',\n            \"tombstone\" => '⊘',\n            _ => '○',\n        }\n    };\n\n    for (i, node) in nodes.iter().enumerate() {\n        let is_cycle = node.path.contains(\"[CYCLE]\");\n\n        // Build tree prefix with proper branching\n        let mut prefix = String::new();\n        if node.depth > 0 {\n            for d in 0..node.depth as usize {\n                if d < node.depth as usize - 1 {\n                    prefix.push_str(\"│   \");\n                } else {\n                    // Check if this is the last node at this depth\n                    let is_last = nodes\n                        .iter()\n                        .skip(i + 1)\n                        .all(|n| n.depth < node.depth || (n.depth == node.depth && n.id > node.id));\n                    if is_last {\n                        prefix.push_str(\"└── \");\n                    } else {\n                        prefix.push_str(\"├── \");\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Truncate title if too long\n        let title = if node.title.len() > 60 {\n            format!(\"{}...\", &node.title[..57])\n        } else {\n            node.title.clone()\n        };\n\n        let cycle_mark = if is_cycle { \" [CYCLE]\" } else { \"\" };\n        let dep_type_str = node.dep_type.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"blocks\");\n\n        println!(\n            \"{}[{}] {} {} (P{}, {}){}\",\n            prefix,\n            node.id,\n            status_symbol(&node.status),\n            title,\n            node.priority,\n            dep_type_str,\n            cycle_mark\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_dep(beads_dir: &PathBuf, dep: DepCommands) -> Result<()> {\n    match dep {\n        DepCommands::Add {\n            issue,\n            depends_on,\n            type_,\n        } => {\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            let dep_type =\n                crate::model::DependencyType::from_str(&type_).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            storage.add_dependency(&issue, &depends_on, &dep_type, \"cli\")?;\n            println!(\n                \"Added dependency: {} depends on {} ({})\",\n                issue, depends_on, type_\n            );\n        }\n        DepCommands::Remove { issue, depends_on } => {\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            storage.remove_dependency(&issue, &depends_on)?;\n            println!(\"Removed dependency: {} -> {}\", issue, depends_on);\n        }\n        DepCommands::List { id } => {\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            let deps = storage.get_dependencies(&id)?;\n            if deps.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"No dependencies found for {}\", id);\n            } else {\n                for dep in deps {\n                    println!(\n                        \"  {} depends on {} ({})\",\n                        dep.issue_id, dep.depends_on_id, dep.dep_type\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        DepCommands::Tree {\n            id,\n            direction,\n            max_depth,\n            format,\n            json,\n        } => {\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            let format = if json { \"json\".to_string() } else { format };\n\n            // Validate direction\n            let direction = match direction.as_str() {\n                \"down\" | \"up\" | \"both\" => direction.as_str(),\n                _ => {\n                    return Err(anyhow!(\n                        \"Invalid direction: {}. Use 'down', 'up', or 'both'\",\n                        direction\n                    ))\n                }\n            };\n\n            if format == \"json\" {\n                // JSON output format\n                if direction == \"both\" {\n                    let down_nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, \"down\", max_depth)?;\n                    let up_nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, \"up\", max_depth)?;\n                    let output = serde_json::json!({\n                        \"root_id\": id,\n                        \"direction\": direction,\n                        \"max_depth\": max_depth,\n                        \"downward\": down_nodes,\n                        \"upward\": up_nodes\n                    });\n                    println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&output)?);\n                } else {\n                    let nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, direction, max_depth)?;\n                    let output = serde_json::json!({\n                        \"root_id\": id,\n                        \"direction\": direction,\n                        \"max_depth\": max_depth,\n                        \"nodes\": nodes\n                    });\n                    println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&output)?);\n                }\n            } else {\n                // Text output format\n                if direction == \"both\" {\n                    // Show both directions separately\n                    println!(\n                        \"Dependency tree for {} (downward - what this depends on):\\n\",\n                        id\n                    );\n                    let down_nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, \"down\", max_depth)?;\n                    print_dep_tree(&down_nodes, &storage)?;\n\n                    if !down_nodes.is_empty() {\n                        println!();\n                    }\n\n                    println!(\n                        \"Reverse dependency tree for {} (upward - what depends on this):\\n\",\n                        id\n                    );\n                    let up_nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, \"up\", max_depth)?;\n                    print_dep_tree(&up_nodes, &storage)?;\n                } else {\n                    let nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, direction, max_depth)?;\n                    print_dep_tree(&nodes, &storage)?;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_label(beads_dir: &PathBuf, label: LabelCommands) -> Result<()> {\n    match label {\n cmd_annotate(beads_dir: &PathBuf, annotate: AnnotateCommands) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = AnnotateCommands::Clear { id } => {\n            storage.clear_annotations(&id)?;\n            println!(\"Cleared all annotations from {}\", id);\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_log(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    id: Option<String>,\n    limit: Option<usize>,\n    since: Option<String>,\n    actor: Option<String>,\n    status_changes: bool,\n    diff: bool,\n    git: bool,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let jsonl_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.jsonl_export);\n    let workspace = beads_dir.parent().unwrap_or(beads_dir);\n\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    // Build filter\n    let mut filter = crate::log::EventFilter::new();\n\n    if let Some(ref issue_id) = id {\n        filter = filter.with_issue_id(issue_id.clone());\n    }\n\n    if let Some(limit_val) = limit {\n        filter = filter.with_limit(limit_val);\n    }\n\n    if let Some(ref actor_val) = actor {\n        filter = filter.with_actor(actor_val.clone());\n    }\n\n    if status_changes {\n        filter = filter.status_changes_only();\n    }\n\n    if diff {\n        filter = filter.with_diff();\n    }\n\n    // Parse since date if provided\n    if let Some(ref since_str) = since {\n        match chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(since_str) {\n            Ok(dt) => {\n                filter = filter.with_since(dt.with_timezone(&chrono::Utc));\n            }\n            Err(_) => {\n                return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\n                    \"Invalid --since date format. Use RFC3339 format, e.g., 2026-05-01T00:00:00Z\"\n                ));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Query events from SQLite\n    let sqlite_events = crate::log::query_events(&storage, &filter)?;\n\n    // If --git flag is set, also query git history\n    let events = if git {\n        let git_events =\n            crate::git_log::reconstruct_events_from_git(workspace, &jsonl_path, id.as_deref())?;\n\n        // Merge git events with SQLite events\n        crate::git_log::merge_events(sqlite_events, git_events)\n    } else {\n        sqlite_events\n    };\n\n    // Apply limit after merging (if limit was set)\n    let events = if let Some(limit_val) = limit {\n        if events.len() > limit_val {\n            // Take the last N events (most recent)\n            events.into_iter().rev().take(limit_val).rev().collect()\n        } else {\n            events\n        }\n    } else {\n        events\n    };\n\n    // Apply actor filter in-memory for git events\n    let events = if let Some(ref actor_val) = actor {\n        events\n            .into_iter()\n            .filter(|e| e.actor == *actor_val)\n            .collect()\n    } else {\n        events\n    };\n\n    // Apply status_changes_only filter in-memory\n    let events = if status_changes {\n        events\n            .into_iter()\n            .filter(|e| {\n                matches!(\n                    e.event_type,\n                    crate::model::EventType::StatusChanged\n                        | crate::model::EventType::Closed\n                        | crate::model::EventType::Reopened\n                        | crate::model::EventType::PriorityChanged\n                        | crate::model::EventType::AssigneeChanged\n                )\n            })\n            .collect()\n    } else {\n        events\n    };\n\n    match format {\n        \"json\" => {\n            println!(\"{}\", crate::log::format_events_json(&events)?);\n        }\n        \"toon\" => {\n            for event in &events {\n                println!(\"{}\", crate::log::format_event_toon(event));\n            }\n        }\n        _ => {\n            if Fast, concurrent-read, serialized-write via WAL mode.\n12\t2. **JSONL is the git artifact** — exported on `bf sync`, committed to git, one entry per bead. Used for backup, cross-machine sharing, and recovery. JSONL is never touched during normal operation.\n164\t\n165\tFunctions:\n166\t- `open(path: &Path) -> Result<Storage>` — open/create DB, apply schema\n167\t- `get_issue(id: &str) -> Result<Option<Issue>>` — point lookup by ID\n168\t- `list_issues(filter: IssueFilter) -> Result<Vec<Issue>>` — filtered query with WHERE clauses\n169\t- `list_all_issues() -> Result<Vec<Issue>>` — full table scan sorted by ID (for JSONL export)\n170\t- `create_issue(issue: &Issue) -> Result<()>` — INSERT\n171\t- `update_issue(id: &str, changes: IssueChanges) -> Result<()>` — UPDATE + mark dirty\n172\t- `close_issue(id: &str, reason: &str) -> Result<()>` — status transition + mark dirty\n173\t- `with_write_transaction(f) -> Result<T>` — execute closure in a write transaction\n174\t- `with_immediate_transaction(f) -> Result<T>` — `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` with retry (see §2.5) — acquires write lock before any reads (used by claim)\n175\t- `rebuild_blocked_cache() -> Result<()>` — recalculate blocked issues materialized view\n176\t\n177\t### 2.3 Sync Protocol (`src/sync.rs`)\n178\t\n179\tPort br's sync semantics:\n180\t\n181\t**Flush (SQLite → JSONL, for git)**:\n182\t1. Call `export_jsonl_dirty` — query dirty bead IDs, export full current state of each from SQLite\n183\t2. Atomic temp+rename over `issues.jsonl`\n184\t3. Handle collisions (same ID, different content) with deterministic resolution\n193\t\n194\t### 2.5 Concurrent Write Safety (`src/storage/sqlite.rs`)\n195\t\n196\tSQLite WAL mode serializes concurrent writers through a single write lock — they queue, not corrupt. `SQLITE_BUSY` is returned when a writer cannot acquire the lock within `busy_timeout`. With claim latency of ~1-2ms and a 20-worker fleet, the entire queue clears in ~20-40ms, so `SQLITE_BUSY` should never occur in normal operation. However, a retry wrapper is the cheap safety net that makes this a guarantee rather than an assumption:\n197\t\n198\t```rust\n199\tconst MAX_RETRIES: u32 = 5;\n200\tconst RETRY_BASE_MS: u64 = 50;\n201\t\n202\tfn with_immediate_transaction<T>(\n203\t    conn: &Connection,\n204\t    f: impl Fn(&Transaction) -> Result<T>,\n205\t) -> Result<T> {\n206\t    let mut attempt = 0;\n207\t    loop {\n208\t        match conn.execute(\"BEGIN IMMEDIATE\", []) {\n209\t            Ok(_) => {\n210\t                let tx = conn.unchecked_transaction()?;\n211\t                return match f(&tx) {\n212\t                    Ok(val) => { tx.commit()?; Ok(val) }\n213\t                    Err(e) => { let _ = tx.rollback(); Err(e) }\n214\t                };\n215\t            }\n216\t            Err(e) if is_busy_error(&e) && attempt < MAX_RETRIES => {\n217\t                attempt += 1;\n218\t                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(RETRY_BASE_MS * attempt as u64));\n219\t                continue;\n220\t            }\n221\t            Err(e) => return Err(e.into()),\n222\t        }\n223\t    }\n224\t}\n225\t\n226\tfn is_busy_error(e: &rusqlite::Error) -> bool {\n227\t    matches!(\n228\t        e,\n229\t        rusqlite::Error::SqliteFailure(\n230\t            rusqlite::ffi::Error { code: rusqlite::ErrorCode::DatabaseBusy, .. },\n231\t            _\n232\t        )\n233\t    )\n234\t}\n235\t```\n236\t\n237\t**Why this is sufficient and not a workaround**: `SQLITE_BUSY` with WAL mode is not data corruption — it is a clean \"lock unavailable, try again\" signal. The database is fully consistent when this occurs. The retry converts a transient contention spike (e.g., 20 workers all starting within the same millisecond) into a short wait rather than a user-visible error.\n238\t\n239\t**All write operations** (`claim`, `create`, `update`, `close`, `batch`) use `with_immediate_transaction`. Read-only operations (`list`, `show`, `ready`) use a plain `BEGIN DEFERRED` transaction and are never affected by write contention.\n240\t\n241\t### 2.7 Doctor/Repair (`src/doctor.rs`)\n242\t\n243\t- `doctor --repair`: Delete `beads.db`, reimport from JSONL\n244\t- `doctor --check`: Validate JSONL line integrity, check SQLite <-> JSONL consistency\n245\t- `doctor --repair --flush-first`: Flush unflushed beads to JSONL before repairing (protects against data loss)\n246\t- `doctor --repair --force`: Force repair even with unflushed beads (WARNING: unflushed beads are lost)\n247\t- **Flush-before-repair rule**: Always run `bf sync --flush-only` before `bf doctor --repair` to protect against losing unflushed beads\n248\t- Recovery from corruption: JSONL export is the authoritative checkpoint for recovery — `beads.db` can be rebuilt from it at any time\n249\t\n250\t**CRITICAL DATA AUTHORITY NOTE**: bead-forge inverts the authority model from upstream beads/br:\n251\t\n252\t| Tool | Source of truth | Checkpoint role |\n253\t|------|----------------|-----------------|\n254\t| beads / br | JSONL (`issues.jsonl`) | SQLite is read-cache |\n255\t| bead-forge | SQLite (`beads.db`) | JSONL is git-tracked checkpoint |\n256\t\n257\tThis inversion is necessary for atomic multi-worker operations. **Beads created or modified since the last `bf sync --flush-only` exist only in SQLite**. Running `bf doctor --repair` without flushing first destroys these unflushed beads.\n258\t\n259\t**Historical context**: On 2026-06-10, seven independent agents across seven workspaces (ARMOR, NEEDLE, AgentScribe, kalshi-weather, jedarden.com, vibe-coding-discovery, face/pose/sun repos) each lost their entire first batch of freshly created beads by running `doctor --repair` after bulk creates. Four db-only beads in ARMOR (bf-4rm7/5zxa/tojg/tr44) were permanently lost. This fix implements the flush-before-repair protection.\n260\t\n261\t---\n262\t\n263\t## Phase 3: CLI Commands\n264\t\n265\t### 3.1 Command Structure (`src/cli/`)\n266\t\n267\tUse `clap` with derive macros.
